title: Veil-rays at Ruchbah Broken Glass Veil (lawless); verdigris curd sold at The Experiment
note: Beyond Voidborn space (orders F13). Seven veil-rays counted 2026-11-15 21:14 UTC by the frontier census. Flown by hand with an empty hold from 21:26 UTC: 0 kills, -77 cr of fuel, no damage; two ships of a large faction joined the fight within three minutes and our hunter fled (guidebook military.md, section 2). Back in the drone plan from 2026-11-15 23:28 UTC as a test with one ship, with `alone` (no fight where a ship that is not ours stands) and `requires.empty_hold` (orders.log ENT-007, block APOPHIS). Ranched like the home herds. 2026-11-16 09:12 UTC (Apophis): status off. The verdigris curd bid (330 cr x 50) left every station of our books between 07:08 and 07:51 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl) and has not come back; the seven drone veil-ray hunts made -1,851 cr in 21 runs from 07:05 UTC (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Back on when a curd bid of 100 cr or more reads again (the tool market); requires.bid on hunt routes is asked of Unity so that this happens by itself. 2026-11-16 13:09 UTC (Apophis): back on (orders.log ENT-014, block APOPHIS). The verdigris curd bid stood again at 330 cr x 50 at seven stations of our books from 12:07 to 12:21 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl). `requires.bid` names the curd bid of the sell station (100 cr, 4 units): the dispatcher closes the route while a book read within the hour shows it gone and opens it when a docked ship reads it back; `min_bid` 100 so that every bid that opens the route also takes the curd. The loss stop holds it until its losing runs of 07:05 to 09:20 UTC leave the six-hour window.
